Chat request with custom stop sequences that terminates generation at a stop token

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'List items until you see STOP', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stop: ['STOP', 'END']))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
```
